section_summary: This section contains State Department correspondence, diplomatic notes, commercial applications, and military clearances concerning travel to, from, and within occupied Japan and Okinawa between June and October 1949. Major topics include processing commercial entrants for trade and property restitution, facilitating Japanese repatriation and emigration, and managing the entry of foreign visitors. The section also highlights SCAP directive SCAPIN 1971/3, which expanded the short-term visitation program to include friends as well as relatives of Japan residents, and addresses congressional inquiries regarding denazification and forced repatriation.
